forum.title: VD6283 eval kit does not work with the GUI 1.0.1
forum.best_answer_content:
Turns out there is a new version of the ALS evalkit. The GUI worked with this one.

![Mulleteer_0-1777296164916.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0ac5c829-b066-261e-648c-58ffe0432ea1.png "Mulleteer_0-1777296164916.png")
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I've P-NUCLEO-6283A1 and downloaded the graphical user interface STSW-IMG301. The quick start guide does not seem to be up to date as I did not find "VD6283\_setup.exe" I was supposed to install, just a plain exe in the zip.

At the first try GUI complained that it cannot communicate with the board. Next I updated the firmware with the GUI. Now when trying to start I get error complaining about invalid product version.

![Mulleteer_0-1776760979108.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/089624f9-4629-3568-6ede-9bf2015f1ce1.png "Mulleteer_0-1776760979108.png")

What is going on here? Does the GUI ship with incorrect firmware binary?

My board

![Mulleteer_1-1776761230139.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/26195d3e-6ec6-9d5f-2b4d-93f5e4df5a48.png "Mulleteer_1-1776761230139.png")
